examples.chinese: A：他是哪國人？ B：他是美國人。
examples.pinyin: A: Tā shì nǎ guó rén? B: Tā shì Měiguó rén.
examples.english: A: Which country is he from? B: He is American.

examples.chinese: 我旁邊有日本同學，前面跟後面都有美國同學。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ pángbiān yǒu Rìběn tóngxué, qiánmiàn gēn hòumiàn dōu yǒu Měiguó tóngxué.
examples.english: There are Japanese classmates beside me, and there are American classmates in front and behind.

items.wordHook: 美(Měi) + 國(country) → Měi is the old sound for 'America': 美國(the USA).

examples.chinese: 他叫什麼名字？你知道嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tā jiào shénme míngzi? Nǐ zhīdào ma?
examples.english: What is his name? Do you know?

examples.chinese: 妳好！我是李中明，請問妳叫什麼名字？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ shì Lǐ Zhōngmíng, qǐngwèn nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
examples.english: Hi, my name is Li Zhongming. May I ask what your name is?

items.wordHook: 名(given name) + 字(character) → the characters of a first name: 名字(name).

examples.chinese: 他在房間外面做什麼？
examples.pinyin: Tā zài fángjiān wàimiàn zuò shénme?
examples.english: What is he doing outside of the room?

examples.chinese: 我的貓在房子外面曬太陽。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de māo zài fángzi wàimiàn shài tàiyáng.
examples.english: My cat is basking in the sun outside the house.

items.wordHook: 外(outside) + 面(side) → the outside: 外面 means out.

examples.chinese: 我男朋友不太喜歡說話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nán péngyǒu bú tài xǐhuān shuōhuà.
examples.english: My boyfriend does not like to talk very much.

items.wordHook: 說(speak) + 話(speech) → 說話 means to talk.

examples.chinese: 在夜市買東西的時候，有些人會跟老闆殺價。
examples.pinyin: Zài yèshì mǎi dōngxi de shíhou, yǒuxiē rén huì gēn lǎobǎn shājià.
examples.english: When shopping at the night market, some people will bargain with the vendor.

examples.chinese: 那件名牌長裙才兩千元而已，用不著跟老闆殺價。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiàn míngpái chángqún cái liǎngqiān yuán éryǐ, yòngbuzháo gēn lǎobǎn shājià.
examples.english: That brand-name long skirt is only two thousand yuan, that's all; there's no need to haggle with the shopkeeper.

items.key: ["B2L04-2-04","吃喝玩樂","吃喝玩樂","吃喝玩乐","Vi"]

examples.chinese: 他每天只會吃喝玩樂，什麼都不做。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zhǐ huì chīhēwánlè, shénme dōu bù zuò.
examples.english: Every day he only eats, drinks, plays, and has fun; he doesn't do anything.

examples.chinese: 想找吃喝玩樂的朋友不難，想有一位知心的朋友卻不容易。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng zhǎo chī hē wánlè de péngyou bù nán, xiǎng yǒu yí wèi zhīxīn de péngyou què bù róngyì.
examples.english: Finding friends to eat, drink, and have fun with is not hard, but wanting to have an intimate friend is not easy.

examples.chinese: 前天下午我在學校的圖書館看書。
examples.pinyin: Qiántiān xiàwǔ wǒ zài xuéxiào de túshūguǎn kànshū.
examples.english: I read at the school library in the afternoon of the day before yesterday.

examples.chinese: 窗戶前面有很多花，很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Chuānghù qiánmiàn yǒu hěn duō huā, hěn piàoliàng.
examples.english: There are many flowers in front of the window. It’s very beautiful.

examples.chinese: 我旁邊有日本同學，前面跟後面都有美國同學。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ pángbiān yǒu Rìběn tóngxué, qiánmiàn gēn hòumiàn dōu yǒu Měiguó tóngxué.
examples.english: There are Japanese classmates beside me, and there are American classmates in front and behind.

items.wordHook: a 䒑(grass top) hides a 刖(blade) chopping at the feet in front → 前(the front).

examples.chinese: 這家咖啡館有免費的無線網路，我可以邊喝咖啡邊上網。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā kāfēiguǎn yǒu miǎnfèi de wúxiàn wǎnglù, wǒ kěyǐ biān hē kāfēi biān shàngwǎng.
examples.english: This café has free Wi-Fi; I can drink coffee while surfing the internet.

examples.chinese: 你得把保證書帶來，我們才能幫你免費修理電腦。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ děi bǎ bǎozhèngshū dàilái, wǒmen cái néng bāng nǐ miǎnfèi xiūlǐ diànnǎo.
examples.english: You have to bring the warranty, and only then can we help you repair the computer for free.

examples.chinese: A: 現在的科技提供非常好用的網路服務，而且很多都是免費的。 B: 好用倒是好用，可是萬一沒有網路，就什麼都做不了了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiànzài de kējì tígōng fēicháng hǎoyòng de wǎnglù fúwù, érqiě hěnduō dōu shì miǎnfèi de. B: Hǎoyòng dàoshì hǎoyòng, kěshì wànyī méiyǒu wǎnglù, jiù shénme dōu zuò bù liǎo le.
examples.english: A: Today's technology provides very easy-to-use internet services, and many are free. B: Sure, it's easy to use, but if there's no internet, then you can't do anything.

examples.chinese: 王老闆舉辦了一個免費吃鬆餅的活動，目的是調查哪種口味的鬆餅最受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn jǔbàn le yīgè miǎnfèi chī sōngbǐng de huódòng, mùdì shì diàochá nǎ zhǒng kǒuwèi de sōngbǐng zuì shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Boss Wang held an event with free waffles; the purpose was to investigate which flavor of waffle is most popular.

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳吃飯，要是滿兩千元，老闆就免費招待一盤炒青菜。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, yàoshi mǎn liǎngqiān yuán, lǎobǎn jiù miǎnfèi zhāodài yī pán chǎo qīngcài.
examples.english: If you spend at least two thousand dollars at this restaurant, the owner will treat you to a free plate of stir-fried greens.

examples.chinese: 這家公司福利不錯，每年除了提供免費健檢，老闆還會帶員工出國旅遊。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī fúlì búcuò, měinián chúle tígōng miǎnfèi jiànjiǎn, lǎobǎn hái huì dài yuángōng chūguó lǚyóu.
examples.english: This company's benefits are quite good; every year, in addition to providing free health checkups, the boss also takes the employees on overseas trips.

examples.chinese: 現代企業越來越重視員工的福利和健康，例如提供免費的旅遊和健檢。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài qǐyè yuèláiyuè zhòngshì yuángōng de fúlì hé jiànkāng, lìrú tígōng miǎnfèi de lǚyóu hé jiànjiǎn.
examples.english: Modern enterprises increasingly value employee benefits and health, for example, providing free travel and health checkups.

examples.chinese: A:公司從明天起就不再提供免費的三餐了。 B:這麼重大的決定，為什麼現在才通知我們？
examples.pinyin: A: Gōngsī cóng míngtiān qǐ jiù bù zài tígōng miǎnfèi de sān cān le. B: Zhème zhòngdà de juédìng, wèishénme xiànzài cái tōngzhī wǒmen?
examples.english: A: Starting tomorrow, the company will no longer provide free three meals. B: Such a major decision—why are we only being notified now?

examples.chinese: 一個國家光是依靠免費簽證，是無法吸引國外遊客來旅行的。
examples.pinyin: Yī gè guójiā guāng shì yīkào miǎnfèi qiānzhèng, shì wúfǎ xīyǐn guówài yóukè lái lǚxíng de.
examples.english: A country solely relying on free visas is unable to attract foreign tourists to travel.

examples.chinese: 這家醫院每個月都到鄉下地區免費為老人門診。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn měi ge yuè dōu dào xiāngxià dìqū miǎnfèi wèi lǎorén ménzhěn.
examples.english: This hospital goes to rural areas every month to provide free outpatient service for the elderly.

examples.chinese: 因為我趕時間，所以得搭計程車去車站。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ gǎn shíjiān, suǒyǐ děi dā jìchéngchē qù chēzhàn.
examples.english: Because I am in a hurry, I have to take a taxi to the station.

examples.chinese: 這個活動不好玩，大家都希望趕快結束。
examples.pinyin: Zhège huódòng bù hǎowán, dàjiā dōu xīwàng gǎnkuài jiéshù.
examples.english: This activity isn't fun; everyone hopes it will end soon.

examples.chinese: 他太晚起床，趕快刷了牙就去上班了。
examples.pinyin: Tā tài wǎn qǐchuáng, gǎnkuài shuā le yá jiù qù shàngbān le.
examples.english: He got up too late; he quickly brushed his teeth and then went to work.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？昨天晚上沒睡好嗎？ B:嗯。要不是開夜車趕報告， 現在也不會這麼沒精神。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Zuótiān wǎnshang méi shuì hǎo ma? B: Ńg. Yàobùshì kāi yèchē gǎn bàogào, xiànzài yě bù huì zhème méi jīngshén.
examples.english: A: What's wrong with you? Didn't you sleep well last night? B: Mm. If I hadn't stayed up late driving to finish my report, I wouldn't be so low on energy now.

examples.chinese: 因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le. Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english: Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over. Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: 這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà. Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english: This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes. Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese: 何小姐走路回家時發覺有人跟在她後面，嚇得她趕快跑進便利商店，不敢回家了。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě zǒulù huí jiā shí fājué yǒu rén gēn zài tā hòumiàn, xià de tā gǎnkuài pǎo jìn biànlì shāngdiàn, bù gǎn huí jiā le.
examples.english: When Miss He was walking home, she came to know that someone was following behind her, which scared her so much that she quickly ran into a convenience store and didn't dare go home.

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 這場大地震發生後不久，軍人就立刻趕到了災區，協助救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn fāshēng hòu bùjiǔ, jūnrén jiù lìkè gǎndàole zāiqū, xiézhù jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: Shortly after this major earthquake occurred, soldiers immediately rushed to the disaster area to assist with disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: 我沒趕上最後一班公車，這下子只好搭計程車回家了。A:糟了，我不小心把隨身碟弄丟了，資料都存在裡面。 B:這下子我們的期末報告都白做了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi gǎnshàng zuìhòu yī bān gōngchē, zhè xiàzi zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē huí jiā le. A: Zāo le, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn bǎ suíshēndié nòng diū le, zīliào dōu cún zài lǐmiàn. B: Zhè xiàzi wǒmen de qīmò bàogào dōu bái zuò le.
examples.english: I didn't catch the last bus; now I have no choice but to take a taxi home. A: Oh no, I accidentally lost my USB drive; all the data is stored in it. B: Now all our final report work has been done in vain.

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: 公司的午餐時間很短，因此同事們總是吃得很趕。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de wǔcān shíjiān hěn duǎn, yīncǐ tóngshìmen zǒngshì chī de hěn gǎn.
examples.english: The company's lunch break is very short, so colleagues always eat in a hurry.

examples.chinese: A:你快點把衣服換好。還不出門，就趕不上飛機嘍？ B:好啦，我知道了。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ kuài diǎn bǎ yīfu huàn hǎo. Hái bù chūmén, jiù gǎn bù shàng fēijī lou? B: Hǎo la, wǒ zhīdào le.
examples.english: A: Hurry up and get changed. If you don't leave now, you won't catch the plane, you know? B: Okay, I got it.

examples.chinese: 他在超市隨手買了瓶飲料，回家後才發現有效日期快到了，只好趕快喝完。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài chāoshì suíshǒu mǎi le píng yǐnliào, huí jiā hòu cái fāxiàn yǒuxiào rìqī kuài dào le, zhǐhǎo gǎnkuài hē wán.
examples.english: He conveniently bought a bottle of drink at the supermarket, and only after getting home did he discover that the expiration date was almost up, so he had no choice but to hurry and finish drinking it.

examples.chinese: 明天的會議改時間了，你趕緊通知大家。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì gǎi shíjiān le, nǐ gǎnjǐn tōngzhī dàjiā.
examples.english: Tomorrow's meeting has been rescheduled; you hurry and notify everyone.

examples.chinese: 下午颱風就要來了，看樣子得趕快去超市買點兒食物。
examples.pinyin: Xiàwǔ táifēng jiù yào lái le, kàn yàngzi děi gǎnkuài qù chāoshì mǎi diǎnr shíwù.
examples.english: The typhoon is coming this afternoon; it looks like we need to hurry to the supermarket to buy some food.

items.wordHook: You 走(walk) through the 旱(dry) desert, pressing on to 趕(pursue).

examples.chinese: 請不要把貼紙貼在教室的桌子上。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bùyào bǎ tiēzhǐ tiē zài jiàoshì de zhuōzi shàng.
examples.english: Please don't stick stickers on the classroom desks.

examples.chinese: 我想要得到便利商店的貼紙，所以花了很多錢買東西。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng yào dédào biànlì shāngdiàn de tiēzhǐ, suǒyǐ huā le hěn duō qián mǎi dōngxi.
examples.english: I wanted to get the convenience store stickers, so I spent a lot of money buying things.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"我參加了愛心服務社以後，想法比以前更成熟了。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"香蕉還沒成熟的時候是綠色的，等變成黃色就熟了。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cānjiā le àixīn fúwùshè yǐhòu, xiǎngfǎ bǐ yǐqián gèng chéngshú le. Xiāngjiāo hái méi chéngshú de shíhou shì lǜsè de, děng biàn chéng huángsè jiù shú le.
examples.english: After I joined the volunteer service club, my thinking has become more mature than before. When bananas are not yet ripe, they are green; when they turn yellow, they are ripe.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"我喜歡週末跟家人聚在一起吃飯、聊天。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"愛心服務社把社員的愛心聚在一起，到安養院去幫助老人。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zhōumò gēn jiārén jù zài yīqǐ chīfàn, liáotiān. Àixīn fúwùshè bǎ shèyuán de àixīn jù zài yīqǐ, dào ānyǎngyuàn qù bāngzhù lǎorén.
examples.english: I like to gather with my family on weekends to eat and chat. The Love Service Club gathers the members' love together and goes to the nursing home to help the elderly.

examples.chinese: 愛心服務社社員去安養院陪老人過年，讓老人們感覺相當溫暖。
examples.pinyin: Àixīn fúwùshè shèyuán qù ānyǎngyuàn péi lǎorén guò nián, ràng lǎorénmen gǎnjué xiāngdāng wēnnuǎn.
examples.english: The members of the Love Service Club went to the nursing home to accompany the elderly through the New Year, making the elderly feel quite warm.

examples.chinese: 許多大學生參加愛心服務的社團，幫助老人打掃環境。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō dàxuéshēng cānjiā àixīn fúwù de shètuán, bāngzhù lǎorén dǎsǎo huánjìng.
examples.english: Many university students join volunteer service clubs to help the elderly clean up the environment.

examples.chinese: 經理說，我們要一邊說笑話一邊介紹機器的功能，這樣子才賣得好。小簡是一個有愛心、有禮貌的人，像這樣子的男人你要好好把握啊！
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ shuō, wǒmen yào yībiān shuō xiàohua yībiān jièshào jīqì de gōngnéng, zhèyàngzi cái mài de hǎo. Xiǎo Jiǎn shì yīge yǒu àixīn, yǒu lǐmào de rén, xiàng zhèyàngzi de nánrén nǐ yào hǎohǎo bǎwò a!
examples.english: The manager said, we need to tell jokes while introducing the machine's functions, this way it will sell well. Xiao Jian is a caring and polite person; a man like this, you should hold on to him!

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: 像食物銀行、愛心冰箱此類處理食物的做法，不但可以節省資源，還能幫助需要的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng shíwù yínháng, àixīn bīngxiāng cǐ lèi chǔlǐ shíwù de zuòfǎ, bùdàn kěyǐ jiéshěng zīyuán, hái néng bāngzhù xūyào de rén.
examples.english: This kind of approach to handling food, such as food banks and love refrigerators, not only can save resources but also can help people in need.

examples.chinese: 陳可欣的舅舅和舅媽都在日本留過學，所以日語說得很好。
examples.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn de jiùjiu hé jiùmā dōu zài Rìběn liú guò xué, suǒyǐ Rìyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: Chen Kexin's maternal uncle and aunt have both studied in Japan, so they speak Japanese very well.

examples.chinese: 每年冬天快到時，舅舅和舅媽就開始計畫去滑雪，有時還約我跟媽媽一起去。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián dōngtiān kuài dào shí, jiùjiu hé jiùmā jiù kāishǐ jìhuà qù huáxuě, yǒushí hái yuē wǒ gēn māma yīqǐ qù.
examples.english: Every year when winter is approaching, my uncle and aunt start planning to go skiing, and sometimes they even invite me and my mom to go together.

examples.chinese: 每個國家都有偉大的人物，值得大家紀念他們。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu wěidà de rénwù, zhídé dàjiā jìniàn tāmen.
examples.english: Every country has great figures who are worth everyone commemorating.

examples.chinese: 「教師節」這個節日是為了紀念偉大的孔子。
examples.pinyin: 「Jiàoshī Jié」 zhège jiérì shì wèile jìniàn wěidà de Kǒngzǐ.
examples.english: The holiday "Teachers' Day" is for commemorating the great Confucius.

examples.chinese: 每個國家都有偉大的人物，值得大家紀念他們。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu wěidà de rénwù, zhídé dàjiā jìniàn tāmen.
examples.english: Every country has great figures who are worth everyone commemorating.

examples.chinese: 我買了幾張當地的明信片，這些是這次旅行很好的紀念。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎile jǐ zhāng dāngdì de míngxìnpiàn, zhèxiē shì zhè cì lǚxíng hěn hǎo de jìniàn.
examples.english: I bought several local postcards; these are a very good souvenir of this trip.

examples.chinese: 這個紀念堂是為了紀念那些為國家犧牲生命的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìniàntáng shì wèile jìniàn nàxiē wèi guójiā xīshēng shēngmìng de jūnrén.
examples.english: This memorial hall is to commemorate those soldiers who sacrificed their lives for the country.

examples.chinese: 孩子是父母最珍貴的寶貝，父母對他們的愛也是最真實的。小文房內的櫃子裡擺了很多寶貝，都是他上山下海帶回來的紀念品。
examples.pinyin: 1. Háizi shì fùmǔ zuì zhēnguì de bǎobèi, fùmǔ duì tāmen de ài yě shì zuì zhēnshí de. 2. Xiǎo Wén fángnèi de guìzi lǐ bǎi le hěn duō bǎobèi, dōu shì tā shàngshān xiàhǎi dài huílái de jìniànpǐn.
examples.english: 1. Children are their parents' most precious treasures, and parents' love for them is also the most genuine. 2. In the cabinet in Little Wen's room, there are many treasures displayed, all souvenirs he brought back from climbing mountains and exploring the seas.

examples.chinese: 紀念郵票一般都是以歷史上的大事或重要人物當作主題。
examples.pinyin: Jìniàn yóupiào yībān dōu shì yǐ lìshǐ shàng de dàshì huò zhòngyào rénwù dàngzuò zhǔtí.
examples.english: Commemorative stamps generally use major historical events or important figures as their themes.

examples.chinese: 這次畢業典禮，學校打算採用空拍的方式來拍紀念影片。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì bìyè diǎnlǐ, xuéxiào dǎsuàn cǎiyòng kōngpāi de fāngshì lái pāi jìniàn yǐngpiàn.
examples.english: For this graduation ceremony, the school plans to use aerial photography to shoot a commemorative video.

examples.chinese: 在觀光景點銷售紀念品，價格通常比一般商店高一些。
examples.pinyin: Zài guānguāng jǐngdiǎn xiāoshòu jìniànpǐn, jiàgé tōngcháng bǐ yībān shāngdiàn gāo yīxiē.
examples.english: Souvenirs sold at tourist attractions are usually a bit more expensive than those in regular stores.

examples.chinese: 這座圓形廣場是為了紀念自由而建的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò yuánxíng guǎngchǎng shì wèile jìniàn zìyóu ér jiàn de.
examples.english: This circular plaza was built to commemorate freedom.

examples.chinese: 我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢。那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé jiějie xiǎoshíhòu cháng wèile qiǎng wánjù chǎo gè méiwán, yǒu shíhòu hái dǎjià ne. Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì qǐng dào le dàjiā zuì xǐ'ài de míngxīng, suǒyǐ ménpiào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.
examples.english: When my older sister and I were little, we often argued endlessly over competing for toys, and sometimes we even fought. That concert invited everyone's favorite star, so the tickets were quickly snatched up.

examples.chinese: A:這個玩具雖然可愛，但是不適合送給剛滿月的孩子，我們還是送紅包吧！ B:也好。送紅包也不錯。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhège wánjù suīrán kě'ài, dànshì bù shìhé sòng gěi gāng mǎn yuè de háizi, wǒmen háishì sòng hóngbāo ba! B: Yě hǎo. Sòng hóngbāo yě bùcuò.
examples.english: A: Although this toy is cute, it's not suitable to give to a child who has just turned one month old; we might as well give a red envelope! B: That's fine. Giving a red envelope is also good.

examples.chinese: 臺灣一般舊公寓的房子大約三十多坪，有客廳、廚房、一間浴室和三間臥房。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yìbān jiù gōngyù de fángzi dàyuē sānshí duō píng, yǒu kètīng, chúfáng, yì jiān yùshì hé sān jiān wòfáng.
examples.english: A typical old apartment in Taiwan is about thirty-something ping, with a living room, a kitchen, one bathroom, and three bedrooms.

examples.chinese: 小年的夢想就是蓋一棟土地面積六十坪、三層樓高的房子，讓全家人都住在一起。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎonián de mèngxiǎng jiùshì gài yí dòng tǔdì miànjī liùshí píng, sān céng lóu gāo de fángzi, ràng quánjiā rén dōu zhù zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: Xiao Nian's dream is to build a three-story house with a land area of sixty ping, so that the whole family can live together.

items.wordHook: A flat expanse of fertile 土(earth) leveled out 平(flat) measures one standard 坪(one "ping"=3.3 square meters).

examples.chinese: 那對雙胞胎姐妹不但長得很像，連性格也一樣開朗、大方。
examples.pinyin: Nà duì shuāngbāotāi jiěmèi bùdàn zhǎng de hěn xiàng, lián xìnggé yě yíyàng kāilǎng, dàfāng.
examples.english: That pair of twin sisters not only look very much alike, but even their personalities are equally cheerful and generous.

examples.chinese: 那兩家便利商店同樣提供客人休息的座位，但是第二家的空間比第一家大多了。林媽媽總是給她的雙胞胎女兒穿同樣顏色、同樣大小的衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nà liǎng jiā biànlì shāngdiàn tóngyàng tígōng kèrén xiūxi de zuòwèi, dànshì dì èr jiā de kōngjiān bǐ dì yī jiā dà duō le. Lín māma zǒngshì gěi tā de shuāngbāotāi nǚ'ér chuān tóngyàng yánsè, tóngyàng dàxiǎo de yīfu.
examples.english: Those two convenience stores similarly provide seats for customers to rest, but the second store's space is much larger than the first's. Mrs. Lin always dresses her twin daughters in clothes of the same color and the same size.

examples.chinese: 我跟弟弟是雙胞胎，很多人都以為我是他，這樣的誤會我早就習慣了。A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn dìdi shì shuāngbāotāi, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒ shì tā, zhèyàng de wùhuì wǒ zǎo jiù xíguàn le. A: Hé xiǎojiě zhǐshì wǒ de línjū, bùshì wǒ de nǚpéngyǒu, dàjiā dōu wùhuì le. B: Nǐ duì tā hěn tǐtiē, bùdàn cháng sòng tā shàngbān, hái cháng péi tā guàngjiē, dàjiā duì nǐmen yǒu wùhuì yě shì zhèngcháng de.
examples.english: My younger brother and I are twins; many people think I am him, and I've long been used to this kind of misunderstanding. A: Miss He is just my neighbor, not my girlfriend; everyone has misunderstood. B: You are very considerate to her; not only do you often take her to work, but you also often accompany her shopping. It's normal for everyone to have a misunderstanding about you two.

examples.chinese: 那對雙胞胎長得很像，個性卻很不同，哥哥很大方，弟弟很害羞。
examples.pinyin: Nà duì shuāngbāotāi zhǎng de hěn xiàng, gèxìng què hěn bùtóng, gēge hěn dàfāng, dìdi hěn hàixiū.
examples.english: That pair of twins look very much alike, but their personalities are very different: the older brother is very outgoing, and the younger brother is very shy.

examples.chinese: 伯父的孩子是對雙胞胎，不只是樣子，連說話的聲音都像。
examples.pinyin: Bófù de háizi shì duì shuāngbāotāi, bù zhǐshì yàngzi, lián shuōhuà de shēngyīn dōu xiàng.
examples.english: My uncle's children are a pair of twins; not only do they look alike, even their speaking voices are similar.

examples.chinese: 這個地區不僅沒有地震、颱風，而且天氣好、空氣新鮮，生活環境安全又舒適。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bùjǐn méiyǒu dìzhèn, táifēng, érqiě tiānqì hǎo, kōngqì xīnxiān, shēnghuó huánjìng ānquán yòu shūshì.
examples.english: This area not only has no earthquakes or typhoons, but also has good weather and fresh air; the living environment is safe and comfortable.

examples.chinese: 現代各式各樣的科技產品，讓人們的生活更舒適、便利。這家旅館每個房間都設計得很現代，吸引不少年輕人來訂房。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài gè shì gè yàng de kējì chǎnpǐn, ràng rénmen de shēnghuó gèng shūshì, biànlì. Zhè jiā lǚguǎn měi gè fángjiān dōu shèjì de hěn xiàndài, xīyǐn bù shǎo niánqīngrén lái dìng fáng.
examples.english: Modern various technological products make people's lives more comfortable and convenient. This hotel's rooms are all designed in a very modern way, attracting many young people to book rooms.

examples.chinese: 管先生這段時間忙著布置新房子，希望給老婆一個又舒適又溫暖的家。
examples.pinyin: Guǎn xiānshēng zhè duàn shíjiān mángzhe bùzhì xīn fángzi, xīwàng gěi lǎopó yí ge yòu shūshì yòu wēnnuǎn de jiā.
examples.english: Mr. Guan has been busy decorating his new house during this time, hoping to give his wife a comfortable and warm home.

examples.chinese: 好餐廳的第一條件就是保持乾淨，讓客人有舒適的環境。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo cāntīng de dì yī tiáojiàn jiùshì bǎochí gānjìng, ràng kèrén yǒu shūshì de huánjìng.
examples.english: The first condition for a good restaurant is to keep it clean, so that customers have a comfortable environment.

examples.chinese: 我認為多看時尚雜誌、多看模特兒怎麼穿衣服，應該就能使自己的穿著更有品味。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi duō kàn shíshàng zázhì, duō kàn mótè'er zěnme chuān yīfu, yīnggāi jiù néng shǐ zìjǐ de chuānzhuó gèng yǒu pǐnwèi.
examples.english: I think that by reading more fashion magazines and looking more at how models wear clothes, you should be able to make your own clothing more tasteful.

examples.chinese: 這個平板的使用說明寫得很詳細，客人自己看就能明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège píngbǎn de shǐyòng shuōmíng xiě de hěn xiángxì, kèrén zìjǐ kàn jiù néng míngbai le.
examples.english: The user manual for this tablet is written in great detail; customers can understand it just by reading it themselves.

examples.chinese: 那個工人使用工廠的機器時，不小心發生了意外，流了很多血。
examples.pinyin: Nàge gōngrén shǐyòng gōngchǎng de jīqì shí, bù xiǎoxīn fāshēng le yìwài, liú le hěn duō xiě.
examples.english: When that worker was using the factory machine, an accident happened accidentally, and he bled a lot.

examples.chinese: 現在大家都習慣用手機照相，一般的相機已經越來越少人使用了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài dàjiā dōu xíguàn yòng shǒujī zhàoxiàng, yìbān de xiàngjī yǐjīng yuèláiyuè shǎo rén shǐyòng le.
examples.english: Nowadays everyone is used to using their cell phones to take pictures; fewer and fewer people use regular cameras.

examples.chinese: 越來越多人使用網路上課，所以手機、電腦也就變成了重要的學習工具。
examples.pinyin: Yuèláiyuè duō rén shǐyòng wǎnglù shàngkè, suǒyǐ shǒujī, diànnǎo yě jiù biànchéng le zhòngyào de xuéxí gōngjù.
examples.english: More and more people use the Internet for classes, so mobile phones and computers have also become important learning tools.

examples.chinese: 國家圖書館和博物館都是公共資源，任何人都可以使用。
examples.pinyin: Guójiā túshūguǎn hé bówùguǎn dōu shì gōnggòng zīyuán, rènhé rén dōu kěyǐ shǐyòng.
examples.english: National libraries and museums are public resources that anyone can use.

examples.chinese: 為了使市區（shìqū， urban area）的交通更便利，目前黃市長正進行各種改善計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shǐ shìqū de jiāotōng gèng biànlì, mùqián Huáng shìzhǎng zhèng jìnxíng gè zhǒng gǎishàn jìhuà.
examples.english: In order to make traffic in the urban area more convenient, right now Mayor Huang is proceeding with various improvement plans.

examples.chinese: 使用地球資源和保護地球環境是相對的，資源使用得越多，環境就越需要被保護。
examples.pinyin: Shǐyòng dìqiú zīyuán hé bǎohù dìqiú huánjìng shì xiāngduì de, zīyuán shǐyòng de yuè duō, huánjìng jiù yuè xūyào bèi bǎohù.
examples.english: Using Earth's resources and protecting Earth's environment are relative: the more resources are used, the more the environment needs to be protected.

examples.chinese: 經過服務人員詳細地說明，使得客人對公司的產品更了解了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò fúwù rényuán xiángxì de shuōmíng, shǐde kèrén duì gōngsī de chǎnpǐn gèng liǎojiě le.
examples.english: After the service staff's detailed explanation, it made the customers understand the company's products better.

examples.chinese: 許多國家因為工業進步得太快，反而使得農業慢慢不被重視了。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō guójiā yīnwèi gōngyè jìnbù de tài kuài, fǎn'ér shǐde nóngyè mànmàn bù bèi zhòngshì le.
examples.english: Because industry in many countries progressed too quickly, it instead made agriculture gradually not be valued.

examples.chinese: 剛學的詞和語法最好常使用、多複習，如此才能加深記憶。
examples.pinyin: Gāng xué de cí hé yǔfǎ zuì hǎo cháng shǐyòng, duō fùxí, rúcǐ cái néng jiāshēn jìyì.
examples.english: It's best to frequently use and review more the words and grammar you've just learned—only in this way can you deepen your memory.

examples.chinese: 這幾年由於市長積極實行交通建設計畫，使當地交通情況明顯改善了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián yóuyú shìzhǎng jījí shíxíng jiāotōng jiànshè jìhuà, shǐ dāngdì jiāotōng qíngkuàng míngxiǎn gǎishàn le.
examples.english: In recent years, because the mayor actively implemented a transportation construction plan, the local traffic situation has obviously improved.

examples.chinese: 身分證是用來證明一個人的身分時使用的。
examples.pinyin: Shēnfènzhèng shì yòng lái zhèngmíng yī ge rén de shēnfèn shí shǐyòng de.
examples.english: An identity card is used when proving a person's identity.

examples.chinese: 在我們學校，上課時是不能使用手機的，連老師也不能破壞規定。那所學校規定學生不能帶手機上學，是希望他們專心學習。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒmen xuéxiào, shàngkè shí shì bù néng shǐyòng shǒujī de, lián lǎoshī yě bù néng pòhuài guīdìng. Nà suǒ xuéxiào guīdìng xuéshēng bù néng dài shǒujī shàngxué, shì xīwàng tāmen zhuānxīn xuéxí.
examples.english: At our school, you cannot use mobile phones during class—even teachers cannot break the rule. That school stipulates that students cannot bring mobile phones to school because it hopes they will concentrate on their studies.

examples.chinese: 印章也叫圖章，華人常在重要的文件上使用印章。
examples.pinyin: Yìnzhāng yě jiào túzhāng, Huárén cháng zài zhòngyào de wénjiàn shàng shǐyòng yìnzhāng.
examples.english: A seal is also called a stamp; Chinese people often use seals on important documents.

examples.chinese: 手機雖然使生活更便利，但過度使用也可能傷害身心健康。人類過度的發展活動，已對動植物的生活環境造成嚴重破壞。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī suīrán shǐ shēnghuó gèng biànlì, dàn guòdù shǐyòng yě kěnéng shānghài shēnxīn jiànkāng. Rénlèi guòdù de fāzhǎn huódòng, yǐ duì dòngzhíwù de shēnghuó huánjìng zàochéng yánzhòng pòhuài.
examples.english: Although mobile phones make life more convenient, excessive use may also harm physical and mental health. Humans' excessive development activities have already caused serious damage to the living environments of animals and plants.

examples.chinese: 政府最主要的任務應是維持並保護社會安全，其次是規畫各種制度，使國家穩定地成長。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zuì zhǔyào de rènwu yīng shì wéichí bìng bǎohù shèhuì ānquán, qícì shì guīhuà gè zhǒng zhìdù, shǐ guójiā wěndìng de chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: The government's most main task should be to maintain and protect social security; next is to plan various systems so that the country can grow stably.

examples.chinese: 過度消費及使用塑膠材料的產品，都會增加自然環境的負擔。
examples.pinyin: Guòdù xiāofèi jí shǐyòng sùjiāo cáiliào de chǎnpǐn, dōu huì zēngjiā zìrán huánjìng de fùdān.
examples.english: Excessive consumption and the use of plastic material products will both increase the burden on the natural environment.

examples.chinese: 所有令人傷腦筋的過程，都是為了使自己變成腦筋很好的人。
examples.pinyin: Suǒyǒu lìng rén shāng nǎojīn de guòchéng, dōu shì wèile shǐ zìjǐ biànchéng nǎojīn hěn hǎo de rén.
examples.english: All the brain-racking processes are for the purpose of making oneself a person with a good brain.

examples.chinese: 這個城市夜晚因各種各樣的彩色燈光，而使得景色既浪漫又迷人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yèwǎn yīn gè zhǒng gè yàng de cǎisè dēngguāng, ér shǐde jǐngsè jì làngmàn yòu mírén.
examples.english: At night, this city, because of various colorful lights, makes the scenery both romantic and charming.

examples.chinese: 新員工在經過專門的訓練後，都已能使用工廠各種生產機器。
examples.pinyin: Xīn yuángōng zài jīngguò zhuānmén de xùnliàn hòu, dōu yǐ néng shǐyòng gōngchǎng gè zhǒng shēngchǎn jīqì.
examples.english: After receiving specialized training, the new employees are all now able to use the various production machines in the factory.

examples.chinese: 為了使客戶安心使用，我們公司產品訂了嚴格的生產標準。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shǐ kèhù ānxīn shǐyòng, wǒmen gōngsī chǎnpǐn dìng le yángé de shēngchǎn biāozhǔn.
examples.english: In order to let customers use them with peace of mind, our company has set strict production standards for its products.

examples.chinese: 一小部分人引起的戰爭使人民付出了相當大的代價。
examples.pinyin: Yī xiǎo bùfèn rén yǐnqǐ de zhànzhēng shǐ rénmín fùchū le xiāngdāng dà de dàijià.
examples.english: The war caused by a small group of people made the people pay a considerable price.

examples.chinese: 亞洲地區發生了嚴重的流行病，使人民受到相當大的生活壓力。
examples.pinyin: Yàzhōu dìqū fāshēng le yánzhòng de liúxíngbìng, shǐ rénmín shòudào xiāngdāng dà de shēnghuó yālì.
examples.english: A serious epidemic broke out in the Asian region, causing people to receive considerable life pressure.

examples.chinese: 亞洲地區發生了戰爭，使人民生活上所受的的壓力相當大。
examples.pinyin: Yàzhōu dìqū fāshēng le zhànzhēng, shǐ rénmín shēnghuó shàng suǒ shòu de yālì xiāngdāng dà.
examples.english: War broke out in the Asian region, causing the pressure that people received in life to be considerable.

examples.chinese: 現在去醫院拿藥，藥袋上都會把藥方及使用方式寫得很清楚。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài qù yīyuàn ná yào, yàodài shàng dōu huì bǎ yàofāng jí shǐyòng fāngshì xiě de hěn qīngchǔ.
examples.english: Now when you go to the hospital to get medicine, the medicine bag always clearly writes the prescription and how to use it.

examples.chinese: 台灣這場地震的規模很大，使許多人受輕傷、重傷。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān zhè chǎng dìzhèn de guīmó hěn dà, shǐ xǔduō rén shòu qīngshāng, zhòngshāng.
examples.english: The scale of this earthquake in Taiwan was very large, causing many people to suffer minor and serious injuries.

examples.chinese: 貓很享受抓癢，但要是你抓錯地方或方式不對，反而會使貓發脾氣。
examples.pinyin: Māo hěn xiǎngshòu zhuā yǎng, dàn yàoshi nǐ zhuā cuò dìfāng huò fāngshì bù duì, fǎn'ér huì shǐ māo fā píqì.
examples.english: Cats really enjoy having their itches scratched, but if you scratch the wrong place or in the wrong way, it will instead make the cat lose its temper.

examples.chinese: 那位教授提供病毒給軍隊使用，有些人認為他應該出來道歉。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi jiàoshòu tígōng bìngdú gěi jūnduì shǐyòng, yǒuxiē rén rènwéi tā yīnggāi chūlái dàoqiàn.
examples.english: That professor provided viruses for the military to use; some people think he should come out and apologize.

examples.chinese: 個人在使用各式各樣的網路服務時，也應該注意隱私問題。
examples.pinyin: Gèrén zài shǐyòng gè shì gè yàng de wǎnglù fúwù shí, yě yīnggāi zhùyì yǐnsī wèntí.
examples.english: When individuals use various kinds of internet services, they should also pay attention to privacy issues.

examples.chinese: 現代的口紅不僅使用方便，在顏色上也有不少變化。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài de kǒuhóng bùjǐn shǐyòng fāngbiàn, zài yánsè shàng yě yǒu bùshǎo biànhuà.
examples.english: Modern lipstick is not only convenient to use, but also has quite a few variations in color.

examples.chinese: 自動化工廠不僅使生產速度更快，同時也能保證產品品質。
examples.pinyin: Zìdònghuà gōngchǎng bùjǐn shǐ shēngchǎn sùdù gèng kuài, tóngshí yě néng bǎozhèng chǎnpǐn pǐnzhí.
examples.english: Automated factories not only make production speed faster but also can guarantee product quality.

examples.chinese: 有朋友與家人的鼓勵，使他在面對任何困難時都十分自信。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu péngyǒu yǔ jiārén de gǔlì, shǐ tā zài miànduì rènhé kùnnán shí dōu shífēn zìxìn.
examples.english: With the encouragement of friends and family, he is very confident when facing any difficulty.

examples.chinese: 他的計畫使公司賠了一大筆錢，因此他以辭職表示負責。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jìhuà shǐ gōngsī péi le yī dà bǐ qián, yīncǐ tā yǐ cízhí biǎoshì fùzé.
examples.english: His plan caused the company to lose a large sum of money, so he resigned to show responsibility.

examples.chinese: 這家工廠使用的大型機械全都是淺綠色的，看起來很有特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng shǐyòng de dàxíng jīxiè quán dōu shì qiǎnlǜsè de, kàn qǐlái hěn yǒu tèsè.
examples.english: The large machinery used in this factory is all light green, and looks very distinctive.

examples.chinese: 環保署規定禁止使用塑膠袋後，使用購物袋的人就漸漸增加了。
examples.pinyin: Huánbǎoshǔ guīdìng jìnzhǐ shǐyòng sùjiāodài hòu, shǐyòng gòuwùdài de rén jiù jiànjiàn zēngjiā le.
examples.english: After the Environmental Protection Administration banned the use of plastic bags, the number of people using shopping bags gradually increased.

examples.chinese: 我的電腦系統無法升級，所以很多功能都不能使用。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de diànnǎo xìtǒng wúfǎ shēngjí, suǒyǐ hěn duō gōngnéng dōu bùnéng shǐyòng.
examples.english: My computer system cannot be upgraded, so many functions cannot be used.

examples.chinese: 當森林漸漸從地球上消失時，可能使全球氣候產生重大的變化。
examples.pinyin: Dāng sēnlín jiànjiàn cóng dìqiú shàng xiāoshī shí, kěnéng shǐ quánqiú qìhòu chǎnshēng zhòngdà de biànhuà.
examples.english: When forests gradually disappear from the Earth, it may cause major changes in the global climate.

examples.chinese: 使用高度技術製造出來的工業生產機器，操作起來往往更有效率。
examples.pinyin: Shǐyòng gāodù jìshù zhìzào chūlái de gōngyè shēngchǎn jīqì, cāozuò qǐlái wǎngwǎng gèng yǒu xiàolǜ.
examples.english: Industrial production machines manufactured using highly advanced technology often operate more efficiently.

examples.chinese: 手機鬧鐘的音量及音樂聲，都可按照個人的使用習慣來調整。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī nàozhōng de yīnliàng jí yīnyuè shēng, dōu kě ànzhào gèrén de shǐyòng xíguàn lái tiáozhěng.
examples.english: The volume of the mobile phone alarm and the sound of the music can both be adjusted according to personal usage habits.

examples.chinese: 潮溼的居住環境不僅使家具不容易保養，並且更可能傷害人體健康。
examples.pinyin: Cháoshī de jūzhù huánjìng bùjǐn shǐ jiājù bù róngyì bǎoyǎng, bìngqiě gèng kěnéng shānghài réntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: A damp living environment not only makes it difficult to maintain furniture, but is also more likely to harm human health.

examples.chinese: 重道德的人，即使在沒人看見的地方也會注意自己的行為。
examples.pinyin: Zhòng dàodé de rén, jíshǐ zài méi rén kànjiàn de dìfāng yě huì zhùyì zìjǐ de xíngwéi.
examples.english: A person who values morality will pay attention to their behavior even in places where no one is watching.

items.wordHook: A 亻(person) dispatches a 吏(government official) to cause an outcome → 使(cause).

examples.chinese: 不少博物館裡的藝術品都是從古代保留到現代的，具有重要的時代意義。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo bówùguǎn lǐ de yìshùpǐn dōu shì cóng gǔdài bǎoliú dào xiàndài de, jùyǒu zhòngyào de shídài yìyì.
examples.english: Many artworks in museums have been preserved from ancient times to the present and have important historical significance.

examples.chinese: 博物館內的藝術品價值都很高，不小心弄壞了可是要賠償不少錢的。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn nèi de yìshùpǐn jiàzhí dōu hěn gāo, bù xiǎoxīn nòng huài le kěshì yào péicháng bù shǎo qián de.
examples.english: The artworks in the museum are all very valuable; if you accidentally damage them, you will have to compensate a lot of money.

examples.chinese: 過年時什麼都漲，連搭計程車的時候，車費都漲價了。
examples.pinyin: Guònián shí shénme dōu zhǎng, lián dā jìchéngchē de shíhou, chēfèi dōu zhǎngjià le.
examples.english: During Chinese New Year everything goes up in price; even when taking a taxi, the fare has increased.

examples.chinese: 這班學生多數都會說法國話，其中有半數是從歐洲來的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bān xuéshēng duōshù dōu huì shuō Fǎguóhuà, qízhōng yǒu bànshù shì cóng Ōuzhōu lái de.
examples.english: Most of the students in this class can speak French; half of them are from Europe.

examples.chinese: 動不動就發脾氣的人，往往無法接受別人的寶貴建議。
examples.pinyin: Dòngbùdòng jiù fā píqì de rén, wǎngwǎng wúfǎ jiēshòu biérén de bǎoguì jiànyì.
examples.english: People who easily lose their temper often cannot accept others' valuable advice.

examples.chinese: 我討厭搬家，因為大型的家具不好搬運。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tǎoyàn bānjiā, yīnwèi dàxíng de jiājù bù hǎo bānyùn.
examples.english: I hate moving because large furniture is hard to move.

items.key: ["B4L13-1-48","一举两得","一舉兩得","一举两得","Ph"]

examples.chinese: 這個新房子沒有很多家具。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xīn fángzi méiyǒu hěn duō jiājù.
examples.english: There is not much furniture in this new house.

items.wordHook: 且(yet) 一(one) 八(eight) wrenches lie on a bench → 具(tool).

examples.chinese: 這項研究計畫只針對少部分區域實驗，參考價值不高。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū jìhuà zhǐ zhēnduì shǎo bùfèn qūyù shíyàn, cānkǎo jiàzhí bù gāo.
examples.english: This research project only conducts experiments in a small number of areas, so its reference value is not high.

examples.chinese: 根據本大樓的管理規定，私人物品不可堆在公共區域。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù běn dàlóu de guǎnlǐ guīdìng, sīrén wùpǐn bùkě duī zài gōnggòng qūyù.
examples.english: According to the management rules of this building, personal items may not be piled up in public areas.

items.wordHook: 上(on top) + 午(noon): the part on top of noon, so the time before noon → morning.
中(central) + 國(country) → the central country, China.
休(rest) + 息(rest) → stop and catch your breath: 休息 means to rest.
八(eight) shares take from 厶(private) hoards → even-handed 公(fair).
a 尸(body) with 丷(horns) and 八(eight) legs crawls into 蜀(Shu) land → 屬(belong to).
Executing duties 按(based on) rules that 照(shine) light on standard procedure: 按照 means according to.
Reading a solemn 苟(urgent) petition aloud before delivering a ceremonial 攵(rap) of the gavel shows formal 敬(respect).
Happening directly while events are 當(appropriate) right at the open scene or 場(classifier for events): 當場 means on the spot.
Combining 自(self) and 在(at): 自在 means be comfortable.
Combining 至(reach) and 少(few): 至少 means at least.
Combining 觀(observe) and 眾(multitude): 觀眾 means audience.
a 豕(pig) rolls in slop as 者(those who) laugh → 豬(pig).
